macro_abstraction.conditions: Finite discounted fully observed MDP with nonempty identical admissible action sets in each abstraction fiber; cost in [0,C], macro representative also in [0,C]; uniform absolute cost error epsilon and total variation delta for projected next state
macro_abstraction.bound: E=epsilon/(1-gamma)+gamma*delta*C/(1-gamma)^2; lifted optimal value gap <=E; lifted macro-optimal policy regret <=2E; pairwise sign certified only when estimated value difference exceeds E_A+E_B.
macro_abstraction.hard_constraint: Admissibility mismatch invalidates bound; do not replace forbidden actions with arbitrary finite penalty. Use refined partition or explicit restriction and separately quantify lost options.
macro_abstraction.novelty: Classical switching cost/real options and approximate stochastic bisimulation; not a novel general law.

limits: Demand transition and cost assumptions not calibrated on software history; equal marginal demonstration is a conditional counterexample, not an observed real-world reversal.
No actual human labor, independent demand or F38 promotion.
No new literature custody; already held Givan et al. 2003 and Sullivan et al. 2001 retrieved.
